The catalogue is nvim-treesitter's parser list at `910fdf6f49e9dee7e7257c7d11a76b040fdfb9de`: each
grammar at the revision nvim-treesitter's queries are written against.
Tags queries come from the grammar's own repository, else Helix at `ba40e547426b`.

| | |
|---:|---|
| 320 | grammars |
| 19 | built and tested by CI |
| 301 | catalogued, not yet built by CI |
| 0 | excluded |
| 4 | parser generated by this repository |
| 167 | with an external scanner (C) |
| 51 | tags query from the grammar |
| 19 | tags query from Helix |
| 44 | licence needing a reading (see notes) |

Query-only languages, inherited by others: ecma, html_tags, jsx.

Every grammar is fetched from a mirror in this repository: the files its build
and its queries read, at the grammar repository's own paths, published as an
orphan commit under `refs/mirror/<owner>/<repo>/<commit>`, or
`<commit>-tree-sitter-<version>` when this repository generated its parser with
that CLI. Its `PROVENANCE` file says what was generated; every other file is
upstream's, unmodified.
